args.text:
Trinity feature: Super Run, Free Flight (PLAYER tab); Super Run ground scaling + Free Flight propulsion.
Role: per-actor locomotion sub-step driver. Per tick it builds the drive velocity for this actor and passes it to the move integrator. Trinity scales the drive vector here because the downstream Havok character-proxy integrator runs a servo that cancels any velocity injected after this point (see src/game/offsets.h:348-380).
PE evidence: PE 2944 (FileVersion 1.0.0.2944), RVA 0x369FF60 / VA 0x14369FF60, section .code, 4225 bytes, 123 basic blocks. Locator kSig_LocoStepper_PE2944 (40 bytes, src/game/offsets.h:401-403) -> exactly 1 match in the whole image, measured over all 12 PE sections with Trinity's own scanner semantics (skip only a section named exactly .debug lacking IMAGE_SCN_MEM_EXECUTE). Trinity records a live install at this exact VA (src/game/offsets.h:397-399).
ABI: RCX = movement component (this). XMM1 = float dt (Trinity declares it only to keep XMM1 intact through the MinHook trampoline; it never reads it). R8 = float* drive velocity x,y,z - a caller scratch buffer near 0x013FDD70, far BELOW kMinPointer, so Trinity must read/write it raw + SEH-guarded, not via mem::Read32/Write32. R9B = a4. a5..a7 on the stack. Return value unused by the caller path Trinity observes.
Data: [component + 0x2C0] = local-player move owner on PE 2944 (0x2B8 modern, 0x298 legacy, 0 unsupported - src/core/version_mapping.cpp:30-46). Observed here at 0x14369ffd6: lea rbx,[rcx+0x2C0]; mov rax,[rbx]; then float4 math on [rax+0x90] and [rax+0x180] - i.e. the move owner is a POINTER stored at +0x2C0, and its +0x90 vector is the same destination vector that VIBE_Locomotion_MoveUpdateIntegrator consumes. Six independent [component+0x2C0] accesses exist in this function (0x14369ffd6, 0x1436a0157, 0x1436a021a, 0x1436a027d, 0x1436a02f7, 0x1436a0742).
Flow: 14 call sites from sub_1436a37f0 (4), sub_14219e4ac (2), sub_14369f000 (1), sub_1436a4ba0 (2), plus further sites. Calls VIBE_Locomotion_MoveUpdateIntegrator @0x144282080 at 0x1436a01f8 with RCX = [rbx] where rbx = r13+0x2C0, proving the move owner is exactly [component+0x2C0].
Trinity: src/game/teleport.cpp - hook hkLocoStep, install at :1903-1933, body :1326-1573; signature selected by core::LocoStepperContractForRevision; offset selector src/core/version_mapping.cpp:30-46. Role: MinHook inline detour (not a patch).
Proof: static = unique 40-byte AOB + prologue byte-compare + 6 move-owner accesses + the call-site RCX=[comp+0x2C0] derivation. live = offsets.h records this exact function installing and firing on PE 2944 with the +0x2C0 owner layout; Super Run / Free Flight were confirmed working in game by the user.
Restore/fail-safe: MinHook detour removed via mem::RemoveHook (MH_DisableHook + MH_RemoveHook) from Teleport::Remove. If the locator is absent the hook is never installed and Trinity logs 'locomotion-stepper hook NOT installed - Super Run/Free Flight disabled'. NOTE: menu.cpp does not gate the PLAYER-tab toggles on this, so on an unsupported revision the toggles stay visible but inert.
Confidence: confirmed
Update notes: re-find with the 40-byte kSig_LocoStepper_PE2944 AOB (expect exact unique). Then re-verify (a) the +0x2C0 move-owner offset, (b) that R8 is still the drive-velocity scratch pointer, (c) that [moveOwner+0x90] is still the destination vector shared with the move integrator. If the drive-vector argument register moves, Super Run/Free Flight must stay fail-closed.

Trinity feature: Super Jump (desired-velocity scaling), map-marker teleport apply, live position readout, and the game-thread tick pump for Player/World/Inventory/Dye/Equipment/Friendly.
Role: per-actor movement update / integrator entry. It consumes the desired velocity, runs the character-proxy integration, and writes the frame's resulting velocity back. Trinity hooks it as the single game-thread heartbeat because it is the only reliable per-frame callback on the local player.
PE evidence: PE 2944 (FileVersion 1.0.0.2944), RVA 0x4282080 / VA 0x144282080, section .code, 142 basic blocks. Locator kSig_MoveUpdate = 48 8B C4 4C 89 48 ? 48 89 50 ? 55 41 56 (14 tokens, 2 wildcards; src/game/offsets.h:325-326) -> exactly 1 match in the whole image, measured over all 12 PE sections. The 6-token prefix alone (48 8B C4 4C 89 48) has 400 matches, so the wildcard tail is what makes this locator unique - do not shorten it.
ABI: RCX = move owner (the Havok character proxy / integrator object). Trinity declares hkMoveUpdate(uint64_t moveOwner, a2..a7) and forwards everything, returning the trampoline's RAX. Only RCX is relied upon; a2..a7 are never read, so ABI drift past the prologue is not detectable from Trinity's side.
Data: moveOwner +0x90 = position, x,y,z,w f32 (kOff_MoveOwner_Position). +0xC0 = desired/input velocity x,y,z,w f32 (kOff_MoveOwner_DesiredVel) - Super Jump scales its up component at index 1. +0xD0 = the velocity the integrator writes back (kOff_MoveOwner_Velocity); Trinity zeroes +0xC0 and +0xD0 when pinning a teleport. +0x1A0 = secondary destination used by the marker-teleport apply. All four are confirmed present in this function's own body (reads/writes at 0x1442822a0 [rbx+0xc0], 0x144282337/0x144282378 [rbx+0xd0], 0x1442823b3 lea r8,[rbx+0x90], 0x1442825c5 lea r13,[rbx+0x90], 0x14428251f lea rdi,[rbx+0xd0]).
Flow: exactly 2 callers - VIBE_Locomotion_StepDriveVelocity @0x14369ff60 at 0x1436a01f8, and sub_1436a37f0 at 0x1436a494e. At the 0x1436a01f8 call site: lea rbx,[r13+0x2C0]; mov rcx,[rbx]; call - which independently proves that the move owner handed to this function is exactly [component+0x2C0], matching Trinity's PE 2944 offset selector. Notable callees: sub_144132270, sub_144134a10, sub_144134f30, sub_144286600, sub_144285a40, sub_144283f10.
Trinity: src/game/teleport.cpp - hook hkMoveUpdate (install :1839-1842, body :1575-1722). Publishes g_playerMoveOwner; applies ApplyJumpScaling before the trampoline; applies a queued map-marker teleport with read-back verification; dispatches Player::Tick, World::Tick, Inventory::Tick, Dye::Tick, Equipment::Tick, Friendly::Tick, ServiceProtectionExpiry; fires a queued native fast travel; builds the fast-travel catalog; publishes the live position readout from moveOwner+0x90 (Super Jump consts src/game/offsets.h:334-346). Role: MinHook inline detour (not a patch).
Proof: static = unique wildcard AOB + prologue + the two caller sites + the [comp+0x2C0] derivation at the call site + the +0x90/+0xC0/+0xD0 field accesses in the body. live = Trinity tracks the local player's coordinates correctly in game, which validates that RCX is the local player's move owner on PE 2944.
Restore/fail-safe: MinHook detour removed via mem::RemoveHook from Teleport::Remove <- Mod::Shutdown. If the locator is absent, teleport.cpp:1841 returns false and position tracking, marker apply, native travel dispatch AND every game-thread tick above are absent. WARNING: src/core/mod.cpp:130 discards that false return, so the overlay still starts with all of those silently missing.
Confidence: confirmed
Update notes: re-find with the full 14-token wildcard AOB (expect exact unique). Then re-verify (a) RCX is still spilled at [rax+10h]/[rax+8h] as the prologue implies, (b) the caller still loads RCX from [component+0x2C0], (c) +0x90 is still position and +0xC0 still the desired velocity. If the caller's +0x2C0 load changes, the marker you are looking at is the wrong function.
Naming note: this function carried the pre-existing user symbol 'Teleport:: Movement-update' (BNINTERNALNAMESPACE, autoDefined=false) from an earlier analysis session. That name is not a game symbol - the binary contains no 'MoveUpdate'/'MovementUpdate'/'Movement-update' string - and its colon-namespace collides with Trinity's own Teleport module. It was renamed to the standard VIBE_ scheme; record the old name here so earlier notes remain traceable.
